title: Farm Match Harvest
description: Swap ripe carrots, pumpkins, and sunny apples across idyllic countryside grids—unleash harvest boosters to complete every cozy farm goal.
controls: Swap adjacent crops to match three or more in a line and collect all target farm harvests.

zh-CN.title: 农场消消消
zh-CN.description: 清新田园风三消农场消消消：滑动交换饱满果蔬触发丰收连锁爆破，解锁特效道具完成每日农场订单！
zh-CN.controls: 滑动交换相邻农作物凑齐三个及以上消除，集齐目标果蔬轻松通关。
